instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

groups.context_line: You will hear a lecturer giving a talk about growing food in cities.
groups.instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: How long did the number of rented plots go on dropping once the peak had passed?
items.evidence: the total fell steadily for fifty years
items.explanation: The speaker says the number of plots fell steadily for fifty years after the peak; the question asks about the length of the decline, not the peak year.

items.prompt: Which of the three forms of urban agriculture does the speaker describe second?
items.evidence: The second is the commercial rooftop farm
items.explanation: The speaker lists the three forms in order: the community garden first, the commercial rooftop farm second, and the controlled-environment farm third.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: Which of the three forms of urban agriculture is set up on top of a building that already stands?
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: cerceve_sozu: soru 'var olan bir binanin ustune kurulan' diyerek cevabin tanimini kendi icinde veriyordu; cati ciftligi adi bu tanimdan dogrudan okunuyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Tanim cerceveden tumuyle cikarildi; soru artik konusmacinin sayma sirasini soruyor. Cevap yalniz 'The second is the commercial rooftop farm' cumlesi duyulunca yazilabiliyor. Cevap, kanit ve turn_index degismedi.
yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: denetim turu: dinleme alistirma yazim kusurlari (2026-08-18)

items.prompt: How many cities did the survey the speaker quotes look at?
items.evidence: examined forty-one cities across Europe and North America
items.explanation: The survey, published two years ago, looked at forty-one cities across Europe and North America.

items.prompt: On the hottest afternoons, how big was the air-temperature difference between a green roof and a bare one?
items.evidence: the air-temperature difference recorded between a green roof and a bare one reached three degrees
items.explanation: Planted surfaces cool their surroundings: on the hottest afternoons the air-temperature difference between a green roof and a bare one reached three degrees. The much larger figure of thirty is the surface reading, which the speaker asks students to keep apart.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: kirli toprakta ne yapilacagi ('yukseltilmis yatak kur') kentsel tarim yazininin standart yaniti.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1+3. Kalem tur 6'ya kaydirildi (L1-S4-17) ve o nokta sesli rakiple ayrildi: 'and do keep that apart from the surface reading, where the gap runs to thirty and where most of the quoted figures come from'. Boylece hem sayinin kendisi seste secilmeyi gerektiriyor hem de kor cozucunun akla getirecegi buyuk rakam acikca baska bir seye ait. Tur 8'e bagli sinav kalemi L1 kisa cevap #37 ('cadmium') korundu.

groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about how water was moved and stored before modern pumps.
groups.instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: If the tunnel is given too little fall, what collects in it and stops the flow?
items.evidence: silt settles instead of travelling, and the channel blocks
items.explanation: When the fall is too small, the silt that should be carried along settles on the floor of the channel and blocks it; when the fall is too great, the tunnel cuts into its own floor instead.

items.prompt: What proportion of the water in an open canal do the field measurements say is lost?
items.evidence: the field measurements support something nearer a third
items.explanation: For the open canal crossing the hot plain, a half is often quoted; the field measurements point to a loss nearer a third.

items.prompt: However well it has been dug, what does the supply from such a channel finally depend on?
items.evidence: it is only ever as good as the water table beneath it
items.explanation: However well the tunnel has been dug, it depends on the water table beneath it; when a modern borehole lowers that level, an eight-hundred-year-old channel can run dry in a single season.

items.prompt: In the hottest part of the summer, how much cooler than ground level are the lowest chambers of a stepped well?
items.evidence: stay about ten degrees cooler than the surface in high summer
items.explanation: Stepped wells are not just a water source; in high summer the lowest chambers stay about ten degrees cooler than the surface.

groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about noise pollution, how it is measured and how it can be reduced.
groups.instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Birds in noisy places sing at a higher pitch. What else does the speaker say they do?
items.evidence: it is not that they sing louder — they start earlier in the morning
items.explanation: The speaker corrects the popular account: the difference is not that the birds sing louder. They sing at a higher pitch and they start earlier in the morning, because the low frequencies of traffic mask the low end of their song.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: desibelin logaritmik olcek oldugu tanim bilgisi, sesi gerektirmiyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1+3. Kalem tur 13'e kaydirildi (L4-S4-32) ve o nokta sesli rakiple kuruldu: 'this is where the popular account goes wrong, it is not that they sing louder — they start earlier in the morning'. Kor cozucunun ilk tahmini (daha yuksek sesle otmek) seste acikca reddediliyor. Tur 2'ye bagli sinav kalemi L4 kisa cevap #32 (6 desibel) korundu.

items.prompt: On the latest count, which source reaches the second largest number of exposed people?
items.evidence: on the latest continent-wide count aircraft reach more people than the railways do
items.explanation: The textbook order puts railways second and aircraft third, but on the latest continent-wide count aircraft reach more people, because flight paths run over dense suburbs while the busiest lines run through open country.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: karayolu-demiryolu-havayolu siralamasi cevre gurultusu yazininin standart sirasi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2+3. Tur 5 yerinde degistirildi (tur sayisi ayni): ders kitabi sirasi acikca anilip reddediliyor, en son sayimda ucaklar demiryolunun onune geciyor. Cevap 'aircraft', celdirici 'railways' seste duruyor. Tur 5'e bagli sinav kalemi L4 kisa cevap #35 ('four fifths') korundu.

items.prompt: What does the speaker say a barrier works by breaking?
items.evidence: a barrier works by breaking the line of sight between the source and the ear
items.explanation: The speaker says a barrier works by breaking the line of sight between the source and the ear; if the wheels are still visible, the wall is not working.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: What has a wall got to interrupt between the traffic and the listener if it is to do any good?
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: cerceve_sozu: 'trafikle dinleyici arasinda neyi kesmesi gerekir' cercevesi kaynak-kulak geometrisini kendisi kurup cevabi adlandiriyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cerceveden 'trafikle dinleyici arasinda' geometrisi silindi; soru artik yalnizca konusmacinin ne dedigini soruyor. Not: bu kalemin ayni alistirmadaki akis semasiyla ortusen ('tekerlekleri gorusten gizleyecek yerde') capraz tekrari senaryo/sema isi oldugu icin bu turda ellenmedi.
yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: denetim turu: dinleme alistirma yazim kusurlari (2026-08-18)

items.prompt: For the practical, how long will students record at each of the two places they choose?
items.evidence: log for an hour at each, in fifteen-minute blocks
items.explanation: For the practical, each student will choose two places and record for an hour at each, in fifteen-minute blocks.

groups.context_line: You will hear a lecturer talking about plastics in the sea and about how they are measured.
groups.instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Under what size is a particle given the name nanoplastic?
items.evidence: Below one micrometre we say nanoplastic
items.explanation: Below five millimetres it is microplastic; once you go below one micrometre, the speaker uses the term nanoplastic.

items.prompt: The speaker says a good part of the disagreement in this field is not about the ocean at all. What is it about?
items.explanation: Closing the list of remedies, the speaker says half the disagreement in the field is not disagreement about the ocean at all: it is disagreement about arithmetic.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: denizde kaybedilen ag/halat/samandira icin Ingilizcede yerlesik tek sozcuk var; tanim sorusu sesi gerektirmiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1. Kalem senaryonun baska bir cevap noktasina kaydirildi (tur 11, yeni L5-S4-33): 'Half the disagreement in this field is not disagreement about the ocean; it is disagreement about arithmetic.' Kor cozucunun uretecegi tahminler (yontem, tanim, olcum) tutmuyor. Ayni turdaki sinav kalemi L5 ozet #40 ('standardising') farkli cumleye dayaniyor, dokunulmadi.
yeniden_uretim.not: Kokteki 'half' sozcugu cikarildi: capraz tarama bunu L1 not tamamlama #35'in cevabi ('half') ile cakisiyor diye rapora sokuyordu.

items.prompt: Since plastic first shows up in the dated layers, how often has the quantity roughly doubled?
items.evidence: the quantity roughly doubling every fifteen years since
items.distractor_used: a decade (the rounding used in the review papers)
items.explanation: In cores from sheltered basins the quantity roughly doubles every fifteen years; the speaker says the review papers round that to a decade, but a decade is too fast for these cores.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: L5 ozet paketinin verili metni 'roughly doubled every fifteen years since' diyerek cevabi duz yaziyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Sizinti kaynagi senaryo turunda zaten kapandi (o cumlecik ozetten cikarilmisti). Kalemin kendisi ayrica saglamlastirildi: tur 8'e sesli rakip eklendi ('the review papers all round that to a decade, but a decade is too fast for these cores'), boylece 'on yil' tahmini seste acikca reddediliyor. Cevap ve turn_index degismedi.
